The plan retains unanswered checkpoints and excluded actions; it requires request origin/method restrictions before entry, including redirects and other requests, with blocked analytics evidence and no relaxation.

Fixture provenance, expected versus observed behavior, checker limitation, retained failures and missing coverage are explicit. No website defect or pass is inferred from the corrected fixture or static check.

The relevant existing checker command has actual argv, UTC bounds, exit 0 and full separately retained stdout/stderr. Future acceptance includes exact source-to-step mapping, evidence requirements and incomplete-bound handling. Literal inventory is correctly limited to presence.

The proposal is confined to documentation, preserves valid keyboard Back/Enter, two distinct focus outcomes, two unanswered checkpoints, question/help absence and the existing 24-step local bound, and justifies additions with supplied sources.

Actual frozen-source reading identifies the remaining help-cycle/documentation gap, while rejecting a missing-Back claim. A concrete proposed replacement and relevant offline check support a bounded documentation decision.
